summary_md:
# Revanschläge för hållbara bolag

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-09-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts (Robert Andersson and Agneta Jönsson) cover the Rejlers–Multiconsult merger, Bravida reaching an all-time high, lower-than-expected Swedish inflation, and upcoming ECB, Fed and Riksbank rate decisions, and they worry that consumers are not ready for higher rates. Robert expects a harsh winter with high electricity prices and argues this could revive quality energy-efficiency stocks such as Nibe, Beijer Ref and Inwido. Agneta sees higher political risk for welfare companies ahead of Sunday's election and advises taking profits in Attendo and Ambea, while arguing that AcadeMedia already prices in much of that risk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Robert thinks Nibe is not a dumb buy even after its rise, as a hedge against high European electricity prices this winter.

#### Reasoning

Host (Robert) expects a harsh winter: oil near $100, low gas and oil stocks, strained state budgets. High electricity prices should revive demand for quality energy-efficiency firms like heat-pump maker Nibe. EU building-efficiency rules and a possible red-green government adding green subsidies are further tailwinds. The hosts note these stocks will not return to 2021 hype levels soon.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the winter is mild and electricity prices stay low
- if rate hikes choke consumer renovation spending
- if green subsidies are not expanded after the election

> *"Jag tror inte Nibe är ett dumt köp faktiskt på de här nivåerna trots att det har kommit upp ganska mycket."*

---

### 🟠 BEIJ-B — Beijer Ref | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

DI colleague's stock of the week. Robert names it as an energy-efficiency play worth watching as electricity prices rise.

#### Reasoning

The cited analyst (Julia Forsberg Thulin, DI) wrote it up as stock of the week. The host places it in the energy-efficiency theme (cooling, some heating and industrial exposure) and suggests looking at green stocks, but gives no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if electricity prices normalize
- if industrial or cooling demand weakens

> *"Vår kollega Julia Forsberg Thulin skrev om Beijer Ref som veckans aktie idag."*

---

### 🟠 INWI — Inwido | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

More consumers may replace windows to save on heating costs. Named among the green stocks to look at.

#### Reasoning

Host (Robert) sees high winter electricity prices plus EU building-efficiency rules pushing homeowners toward window upgrades, which benefits Inwido. This is speculative and part of the broader green-stock theme, not an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the consumer weakens further from rate hikes
- if electricity prices stay moderate

> *"Jag tror absolut att det är fler som kika på att byta fönster med ett Inwido."*

---

### 🔴 ATT — Attendo | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Up 48% YTD with a high valuation and peak margins. Rising election risk (LOV changes, welfare profit ban). Agneta: take profits.

#### Reasoning

Host (Agneta) says political risk for care companies is higher this election. Possible LOV changes, a profit ban in welfare, a Norway-style deprivatization inquiry and wealth taxes could freeze the sector. Valuation of 15-16x earnings, target-level margins and 8-10% growth leave a big drop if the Swedish business locks up.

#### Sell Triggers

- thesis weakens if the right-wing bloc wins the election
- if LOV remains unchanged and no profit-ban inquiry starts

> *"Så slutsatsen blir ju att ta hem vinsten i Ambea och Attendo."*

---

### 🔴 AMBEA — Ambea | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Up 21% YTD and merging with Humana. High valuation and election-driven political risk for care operators. Agneta: take profits.

#### Reasoning

The same argument as for Attendo: a red-green win could bring LOV changes, a welfare profit ban and wealth taxes that freeze investment and new entrants. The high valuation (15-16x earnings) and peak margins raise the downside, and a large share of the business is in Sweden.

#### Sell Triggers

- thesis weakens if the right-wing bloc wins the election
- if political proposals on LOV or profit caps are dropped

> *"Så slutsatsen blir ju att ta hem vinsten i Ambea och Attendo."*

---

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Valuation has fallen to about 10x this year's and 8x next year's earnings. International and adult education (44% of revenue, target 50%+) cuts Swedish political risk.

#### Reasoning

Host (Agneta) argues much of the school political risk is priced in, since the stock trades far below its historical 15-16x. It is diversifying away from Swedish schools through acquisitions, with a 7.4% operating margin. The CEO hinted at larger acquisitions, and the dividend decision comes after the election.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a left-wing government moves to deprivatize schools quickly
- if international expansion or acquisitions stall
- if margins deteriorate

> *"Där tror jag faktiskt att man har prisat in en hel del av den politiska risken, för skolan är ju den som man har pratat mest om."*

---

### 🟡 BRAV — Bravida | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Up 58% since DI's January recommendation, at an all-time high on data/AI center orders. Q3 orders are softer so far and the hosts are monitoring.

#### Reasoning

The hosts' recommendation has worked, with large data and AI center orders in Norway and Sweden. They note smaller Q3 orders so far (summer effect) and say they will check whether the valuation is reasonable and come back to it. That amounts to a hold with monitoring.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data/AI center order intake slows materially
- if the valuation is judged no longer reasonable after review

> *"Så att vi håller koll på den där och ser om det här är rimligt. Så vi får återkomma i frågan."*

---
